stimulus.question: Checkout is reported to show elevated errors in the OTel Demo. Using the authorized metrics range query and trace search for the last 5 minutes, determine whether checkout and its dependency calls (payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email) show failures or elevated latency, cite trace ids, and return a json investigation report.

claims.text: In the 5-minute window checkout recorded error spans: oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder STATUS_CODE_ERROR increase 1.25 against STATUS_CODE_UNSET 5, and oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct STATUS_CODE_ERROR increase 1.029. The rpc_server_duration series for checkout shows PlaceOrder with rpc_grpc_status_code=13 increase 1.25 and rpc_grpc_status_code=0 increase 3.75.

Trace 837b8646f7d7c1d213213ee982b8183c shows checkout service span 6678cf31ab9ab2ce (oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, start_us 1793718038328909 = 15:00:38Z) with error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR, rpc.grpc.status_code=13 and otel.status_description 'failed to prepare order: failed to get product #"OLJCESPC7Z"'.

In the same trace, checkout's client span 10012593e24427b9 (oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, error, gRPC 13) carries 'Error: Product Catalog Fail Feature Flag Enabled', and the corresponding product-catalog service span 0c8e964d81e5db46 (oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct) carries the same description with gRPC 13. A separate product-catalog trace cb9c31e8944d6a615b208aabc9a9b3aa shows product-catalog span b65caff292c37d74 failing with the identical message.

product-catalog itself recorded 4.116 error spans on oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct in the window (against 125 STATUS_CODE_UNSET GetProduct spans), i.e. a partial failure rather than a total outage; its GetProduct server spans that failed completed in 147 µs (trace cb9c31e8...) and 21 µs (trace 837b8646...).

The other checkout dependencies show no failure evidence in the window: payment STATUS_CODE_ERROR increase 0 (10 UNSET spans), cart STATUS_CODE_ERROR 0 (180 UNSET), currency only STATUS_CODE_OK (13.75), shipping only UNSET (15), and email only UNSET spans (5 'POST /send_order_confirmation', 5 'send_email', 10 'sinatra.render_template') with no error series; checkout's Charge, GetCart, EmptyCart, GetQuote, ShipOrder and GetProduct client calls appear with rpc_grpc_status_code=0 in the window.

No latency elevation is supported against comparable baselines: checkout PlaceOrder server average 48.74 ms (14:57:22–15:02:22) vs 48.97 ms (14:02:22–14:07:22); product-catalog GetProduct server average 0.287 ms vs 0.271 ms; checkout client averages in-window vs the preceding 5 minutes (14:52:22–14:57:22) are Charge 12.96 vs 8.72 ms, Convert 2.93 vs 1.71 ms, GetCart 1.04 vs 1.58 ms, GetProduct 0.55 vs 0.49 ms, GetQuote 8.99 vs 7.71 ms, ShipOrder 0.59 vs 0.67 ms, EmptyCart 9.90 vs 36492.90 ms.

Checkout also completed orders successfully in the window: traces c2b29b14c5d0f5262aa8b2c58637cbb1, 333c4c62606a9e2cfd3008c20faa6de1, 4cd5c5b53ef11dafd9eeb9432567acb2, f38b7b3eb0addd0e9fd57e6742df4fb3 and 8310e29b410cebf8586a9f8d4cc18609 contain checkout PlaceOrder spans with rpc.grpc.status_code=0 and child client spans Charge, GetCart, EmptyCart, Convert, GetQuote, ShipOrder and GetProduct with status code 0.

A separate earlier error episode on checkout was on its cart dependency: checkout error spans attributed to span oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart were 2.5, 1.25, 5.01, 3.75, 2.5, 3.75, 3.74 per 5-minute step from the 14:32:22Z step through 14:57:22Z and 0 at 15:02:22Z, while cart's own 'POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart' error spans followed the same cadence and checkout's EmptyCart client calls carried rpc_grpc_status_code=9 in those same steps and 0 in the last step. Checkout's PlaceOrder error series was 0 until the 15:02:22Z step.

Frontend, a caller outside the listed checkout dependencies, shows its own error spans tied to the same product-catalog message: frontend error spans include grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 3.087, executing api route (pages) /api/products/[productId] 2.058, executing api route (pages) /api/recommendations 1.029 and GET 3.75 in the window, and trace cb9c31e8944d6a615b208aabc9a9b3aa contains frontend span 9f0b7327c2671503 (executing api route (pages) /api/recommendations, http.status_code 500) with exception message '13 INTERNAL: Error: Product Catalog Fail Feature Flag Enabled'.

The product-catalog GetProduct failures are produced by an enabled 'Product Catalog Fail' feature flag inside product-catalog, as stated verbatim by the failing span's status description ('Error: Product Catalog Fail Feature Flag Enabled'); no evidence in this Run shows who enabled it, when, or how.

Checkout's current PlaceOrder errors are caused by this product-catalog GetProduct failure: the faulting GetProduct client span sits under checkout's prepareOrderItems span and then PlaceOrder via visible parent references, and the PlaceOrder status description names 'failed to get product #"OLJCESPC7Z"'; a single failing GetProduct is sufficient to fail the order, which is consistent with the observed partial failure rate at product-catalog.

Cart failures being the cause of checkout's errors in the last 5 minutes is rejected: cart's own error spans on POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart are 0 and checkout's EmptyCart client calls show rpc_grpc_status_code=9 increase 0 in the 14:57:22–15:02:22 window, while the cart-related error episode belongs to the earlier 14:32–14:57 steps.

The rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count series for checkout reports increase 0 for rpc_method=GetProduct with rpc_grpc_status_code=13 in the window, even though traces_span_metrics records a checkout GetProduct error span and rpc_server_duration records checkout PlaceOrder gRPC 13; the two metric families therefore disagree on the error magnitude and the exact error counts remain uncertain.

gaps: kube-state, pod logs and change history are not integrated in this Run, so no deployment, restart, configuration or flag-change evidence exists to explain when or why the 'Product Catalog Fail' feature flag became active.

report_parsed.summary: In the last 5 minutes (2026-11-03T14:57:22Z–15:02:22Z) checkout shows its own error spans: oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder errored (1.25 error-span increase vs 5 STATUS_CODE_UNSET, and rpc_server_duration shows 1.25 spans at rpc_grpc_status_code=13 vs 3.75 at code 0), plus 1.03 error spans on its client call oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct. The deepest supported cause is product-catalog: its own server span oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct errored with the exact diagnostic text 'Error: Product Catalog Fail Feature Flag Enabled' (gRPC 13), trace 837b8646f7d7c1d213213ee982b8183c (checkout span at 15:00:38Z: 'failed to prepare order: failed to get product #"OLJCESPC7Z"') and trace cb9c31e8944d6a615b208aabc9a9b3aa. The other checkout dependencies show no failure evidence in this window: payment, cart, currency, shipping and email have zero error spans/series. No latency elevation is supported: checkout PlaceOrder server average is 48.74 ms vs 48.97 ms an hour earlier, product-catalog GetProduct server average 0.287 ms vs 0.271 ms, and the failing GetProduct spans returned in 21–147 µs. A separate, earlier checkout error episode (14:32–14:57) was on oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart with gRPC status 9 and matching cart-side error spans; it had ended by this window and is not the cause of the current errors.
